name: Greenland Day Camp (YMCA Camp Gundalow)
operator_name: The Granite YMCA (YMCA of the Seacoast)
description_short: YMCA day camp at Camp Gundalow in Greenland, NH, for children entering grades 1–9, grouped by grade, with swimming, archery, sports, arts and STEM; there are also specialty camps and a trip-based camp for grades 7–9. The camp also runs teen leadership programs: LIT for grades 8–9 and CIT for grades 10–11.

refund_policy_summary: Each week needs a $35 nonrefundable deposit. Cancel more than 6 weeks before the camp week: full refund less the deposit. Cancel 3 to 6 weeks before: refund less a $65 admin fee and the deposit. Cancel less than 3 weeks before: no refund. Payment is due in full at registration.
